alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 5 at 8:50AM PDT until October 5 at 12:00PM PDT by NWS Seattle WA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Areas of visibility one half mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Portions of northwest and west central Washington.

* WHEN...Until noon PDT today.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.

sonora_ca.name: Sonora
sonora_ca.obs_note: Sonora has no NWS observing station. The readings come from the Green Spring fire-weather station, 12 miles away and about 700 ft lower.

alerts.headline: Heat Advisory issued October 5 at 9:42AM PDT until October 9 at 10:00PM PDT by NWS Sacramento CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...High temperatures of 94 to 102 degrees expected and
overnight low temperatures in the mid 60s to low 70s, with
widespread Moderate HeatRisk and areas of Major HeatRisk.

* WHERE...The Sacramento and northern San Joaquin Valleys, Delta and
Carquinez Strait, and foothills.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM PDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures may cause heat illnesses, especially to
anyone without effective cooling and/or adequate hydration.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Hottest days expected Monday through
Wednesday.

alerts.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued October 5 at 2:46AM PDT until October 9 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with high temperatures near 110
degrees and overnight lows only getting down to around 85 degrees.
This will yield at least major heat risk, impacting anyone without
adequate cooling and hydration.

* WHERE...Elevations in Death Valley National Park below 2000 feet.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat events.
